caseName: Torain v. Siemens Rolm Communications, Inc.
caseNameFull: Torain v. Siemens Rolm Communications, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until May 18, 1998, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 88(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
